name: Litchi
description: Wow, good luck indeed! Pinku uses fruit elements as the creative source, adds lucky meanings, and creates metal puzzle "lucky fruit", giving traditional pendants a more interesting and creative way to play. "Lucky Fruit" is a set of 4 types, with cherries, pomegranates, lychees, and peaches as elements, and auspicious floral decorations such as auspicious clouds, lanterns, and flowers, respectively corresponding to four kinds of beautiful blessings: "cherry blossoms," "stones come and turn," "natural lychees," and "loving peach." The luck index soared instantly.
